name: Happiness 2
tagline: Thirty-four homes across four acres in Vijayanagar.
description: Happiness 2 is a completed villa community in Vijayanagar 4th Stage. Thirty-four homes sit on four acres — thirty-two 3 BHK villas of 2,543 sq ft, plus two apartments.

contentWarnings: The two apartments within the 34 homes have no published configuration, area or availability. Only the 32 villas are described.
Gallery images are renders, not photographs of the completed community. This project is marked completed, so photography should exist and should replace them.

Areas are the brochure's floor-by-floor built-up and carpet figures added together: ground + first + second. The second floor is offered with and without its multipurpose area, which is why every type is a range. Per-floor figures are in the brochure if a breakdown is wanted on the page.

The brochure's connectivity page is headed with a paragraph about Blessed, not Happiness II, and the location map shows Happiness. Both are in Vijayanagar 4th Stage. The distances are carried here as Happiness II's — confirm, and fix the brochure.

The two hospital columns on the brochure's QUICK CONNECT panel are a grid the PDF flattens into one stream, so the pairing of distance to hospital name is inferred from reading order. Verify the five health figures against the printed page.

The brochure names the developer as MK Infra Holding, MB Road, Srirangapatna 571438. The site records the group's legal name as M.K. Agrotech Pvt. Ltd., which is the oil business. Confirm which entity is the promoter on RERA.
